name: Explosive Trap
description: Place a fire trap that explodes when an enemy approaches, causing (Ranged Attack Power * 0.1 + 201) to (Ranged Attack Power * 0.1 + 257) Fire damage and burning all enemies for 330 additional Fire damage over 20 sec to all within 10 yards.  Trap will exist for 1 min.  Only one trap can be active at a time.
